materials.reason: Town Center roof contains overlapping courses, dormer, perspective and directional shadow. Whole-roof projection would duplicate mesh structure; unobstructed fibres occupy only small patches.
Timber beams are narrow and crossed by joints/outline. Existing material-reference has isometric planks and frame; insufficient independent edge-to-edge beam grain.
Individual blocks are small and divided by grout. A masonry-wall crop would create bricks inside the existing 3D bricks.
Infill is broken into small perspective panels by timber framing and banners. Existing clay plaster reference has slab edges and a different wall character.
Banner pixels include outline, folds, motif, hanging shape and cast shading. Cropping them as a repeating cloth would bake a second banner into the surface.
